findings.title: Redundant Content-Type headers
findings.description: Both showCreateFacilityModal and showEditFacilityModal explicitly pass headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } to apiFetch. The apiFetch function already sets this header by default, so the explicit header is redundant but harmless. Remove the headers object from both calls to match the members.js pattern.

findings.title: PagedResult uses Data, not Items
findings.description: The plan specified renaming PagedResult.Data to PagedResult.Items to match frontend expectations after camelCase conversion. PagedResult.cs still uses Data, which becomes 'data' in JSON. Test the Facilities page in a browser to confirm whether the frontend expects 'items' or 'data'. If the table loads correctly, no change is needed. If it shows 'Không có cơ sở nào' despite facilities existing, the Data→Items rename is required.
